description: **C10b, ROADMAP.** A pruner that proposes and a person approves: on a schedule or on demand, Compose lists candidate cuts in a project's tests, rules and Markdown (dead, duplicate, never-loaded, permanently red or skipped), each with who still uses it and what covers it instead; nothing is deleted until a person approves that item, and an approved cut is reversible. Never auto-deletes; security, tenancy and ownership checks are never proposed without equivalent coverage named.
